name: Demo Extension
description: Showcase: agent tools (greeting + file API), an async slash command, event hooks (lifecycle + tool events), a chat UI widget, and a theme — all in one .minisx.
author: Minis Example

settings.label: Greeting prefix
settings.description: Prefix used by the ext-hello command and hello_world tool.

settings.label: Uppercase output
settings.description: When on, the greeting is uppercased.

tools.name: hello_world
tools.description: Returns a greeting. Demonstrates a minimal extension tool.

tools.name: notify_widget
tools.description: Broadcasts a message to the extension's UI widget via minis.api.ui.postMessage.

tools.name: demo_notes
tools.description: Demo of the file API: list/read/write/delete notes under /var/minis/shared/demo-notes.

commands.name: ext-hello
commands.description: Slash command: says hello from the extension
